all.name: Cloak & Dagger
all.description: Tyrone Johnson and Tandy Bowen are nearly inseparable, like two sides of the same coin. Intertwined by forces of shadow and light, Cloak & Dagger fight as a united front, dealing havoc and healing allies across the arena.

item.name: Lightforce Dagger
item.description: Unleash a bouncing <Orange>Lightforce Dagger</> to damage enemies and heal nearby allies.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile that generates a spell area upon impact
additional_fields.Special_Effect: The projectile features an attraction effect, pulling in the closest target to the crosshair and creating a spell field upon impact. This spell field provides healing effects

item.name: Dagger Storm
item.description: Launch a volley of daggers, creating a <Buff>Healing-Over-Time</> field in the impact area. Allies in the area gain One-Time Healing when the field appears.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field
additional_fields.Cooldown: Veil of Lightforce & Terror Cape share charges, capped out at 2 with each taking 10s to recharge. After using either, both abilities enter a 2s cooldown
additional_fields.Special_Effect: When a Spell Field is created, allies in range get a One-Time Healing of 60

item.name: Shadow's Embrace
item.description: Switch to Cloak.

item.name: Light's Embrace
item.description: Switch to Dagger.

item.name: Light Explosion
item.description: Deploy a Veil of Lightforce to heal allies upon touch and grant them a <Buff>Healing Boost</>.

item.name: Terror Cape
item.description: Deploy a Veil of Darkforce to damage enemies upon touch, applying <Debuff>Blind</> to narrow their sight and <Debuff>Vulnerability</> to amplify damage received.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: The spell field advances along the casting path

item.name: Eternal Bond
item.description: Perform four rapid dashes, healing allies and damaging enemies along the path.

additional_fields.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 4m radius and 15m in length

item.name: Darkforce Cloak
item.description: Inflict continuous damage to an enemy.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Attacks will target the nearest enemy to the crosshair, dealing damage

item.name: Dark Teleportation
item.description: Enshroud nearby allies in the Darkforce Dimension and grant them <Buff>Phased</>, making them untargetable and invisible to enemies and granting them a <Buff>Movement Boost</>.

additional_fields.Cooldown: Veil of Lightforce & Terror Cape share charges, capped out at 2 with each taking 10s to recharge. After using either, both abilities enter a 2s cooldown
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Allies within the area gain Invisibility and Movement Boost
